200001.description:
Sakura Kirishima is a flawless beauty who serves as the student council president. She works diligently everyday at the student council, honing her leadership skills with the goal of becoming Prime Minister someday. But then she runs into Seijiro Tanabe, the handsome but eccentric president of the Biology Club. Swept up by his passion for biological study, Sakura is about to experience the predatory side of Seijiro Tanabe's personality!

(Source: Magapoke, translated)

title.native: せいぶつ部の田辺くん

200002.description:
"If three people do it... it's not cheating, right?"

On the day I had sex for the first time with my boyfriend of two months, I also had sex with his older brother. I really love him, but his older brother is so delicious...! It seems like the pleasure is stronger than the guilt, and the pheromones are a little stronger than the love.

"Can't we both do it together?"

Two brothers entered one hole.

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

200003.description:
The years have felt hollow ever since Hayate lost his beloved dog, Rikimaru. But after losing his ordinary life in a freak accident, Hayate is reincarnated in a fantasy realm whose resident Goddess tasks him with saving her world from impending doom—and gives him the chance to reunite with Rikimaru.

The twist is, Hayate's not the one playing hero. His pup is! Granted the might of a legendary savior, Rikimaru wastes no time in vanquishing evil and enjoying his zoomies. Meanwhile, the good-natured and congenial Hayate is forced to navigate strange, new lands and thorny political intrigue. Still, if there's one thing Hayate knows, it's that he wants to do right by the innocents of this world...and pamper his lovable little pumpkin every step of the way!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

200005.description:
Nam Jin-Seo, who developed his esper skills at a young age and worked as a trainer at the center for nearly 20 years, was tasked with intensively training Go Won-Hun, who developed his esper skills later than others, at the center director's request to quickly train him as an S-rank esper and send him into the field. Go Won-Hun, experiencing his first taste of guiding and discovering a world of his own, became obsessed with him from that day on.

"Senior, you're an A-rank esper, so you must have been very helpful to other espers, too. Why can't you do anything better than this?"

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

200006.description:
Jeong Eui-Jun, an entertainment reporter for a gossip magazine, is commissioned to investigate Gu Hyun-Seong, a second-generation chaebol who started out as a child actor. During the sluggish investigation, Eui-Jun impulsively sleeps with Hyun-Seong. Worse, he's caught being a reporter! Eui-Jun imagines the worst possible outcome. But Hyun-Seong, with a sly smile, makes a new proposal...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
synonyms: อยากได้สกู๊ปพิเศษเหรอครับ คุณนักข่าว?!

200007.description: A new comic, depicting what has happened 10 years after the selector series!

200009.description:
Isamu's father, Dr. Shigeno, is a genius scientist. and created new a revolutionary invention. A former research ally, Dr. Kusai, begins to hunt the two, who now will have to do everything they can to prevent the secret formula from falling into the wrong hands.

(Source: Novo Verso, translated, edited)

200010.description:
Grace and Henry are childhood friends and engaged to be married until Grace’s family loses everything after being charged with treason. With her parents dead and nowhere to go, Grace is taken in by Henry’s family to work as their maid. But with that comes the duty of serving her fiancé-turned-master at all hours of the day, even at night...

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: How to Make That Maid Mine

200011.description:
You're the monster that can save me from this hell.

As soon as she comes of age, Linnea is married off to an aristocrat in exchange for a sizeable dowry. She finds solace in Aleksis, her new husband's son. However, terrible secrets surrounding the family come to light as soon as they cross the forbidden line. Will she be able to escape from this hell?

(Source: Manta)

200012.description:
Childhood Friends x Codependency x Violence = Platonic Love

Megumi, a girl with a tendency to be a bit of a jerk, and Nagi, the class president, are childhood friends. They spent all their childhood together, but as time passed and they became high school students, their relationship became increasingly strained. Unable to accept that Megumi was drifting away from her, Nagi ripped off the earrings that Megumi had given her as a friend. Megumi explodes with rage, and Nagi, pleased by her reaction, continues her erratic behavior. Will the two be able to rekindle their friendship? This is a 33-page, downbeat yuri short story, smeared with blood, sweat, and tears.

"Megumi... I'm sorry. Let's kiss to make up, like we used to."
"...Die."

(Source: Author's Website, translated)

200014.description:
Stop the resurgence of the Sinwolmun, a group seeking to rule the world through demons!

Late at night, in a noisy gambling house, a ruffian bets on the family's stolen sword. The legendary Seven-Star Sword, said to control demons, is revealed. Moments later, the Sinwolmun's disciple, Sacheonpaehwang, appears from nowhere. The gambling house is devastated, corpses strewn about. Since that day, the martial arts world has been plagued by a series of gruesome and brutal incidents. The Inryungjo, a martial arts investigation agency specializing in arresting unsolved cases, is dispatched to the scene of these unsolved cases. Recognizing the emergence of a vast dark force, they hunt down its source. Meanwhile, Hui-Yeon, disguised as a man and joining the Inryungjo to avenge her family, is caught on the first day by the group's leader, Beom-Yeop. However, for some reason, Beom-Yeop forces Hui-yeon to remain in the Inryungjo.

Can the Inryungjo prevent the resurgence of the Sinwolmun, once thought lost to legend?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

200015.description:
On the first night, the master's bride disappeared. In the princess's now empty bedroom, the master commanded Evely, who was at a loss: "You will take the princess's place." It began as a half-joke, but the maid's impudence, fearful yet unflinching, aroused his cruel instincts.

"My, my lord."

"Yes. I am your master. So, Stick your tongue out.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
synonyms: メイドの夜～伯爵様と私の秘夜～

200016.description:
White Cat School is a school attended by cats who are still white and who have the potential to join the "White Cat Knights," an organization made up entirely of white cats. Students who graduate without their fur becoming colored join the prestigious White Cat Knights, but those whose fur becomes colored have their dreams shattered and disappear without a trace...

The students who attend this strict yet dream-filled school study hard every day, dreaming of one day becoming a member of the White Cat Knights. The protagonist, Col, is one of them, with his innocent, cheerful, and simple personality. However, when his best friend Leonis, who has sworn to become a knight with him, starts to get colored fur, will he begin to change...?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

200017.description:
As a cat shapeshifter, there's no way Go Yi-Jun could be attracted to a rodent. That is, except for his crush, chinchilla Kwon Na-Ra. But when Na-Ra's cousin, mouse shifter Jiheon, enters his life, Yi-Jun finds himself continuously caught up with him! And for some reason, he doesn't seem to mind it. Yi-Jun tells himself it's just forced proximity (and maybe a little horniness), but is that really all this is? Or will their time together prove that a cat really can learn to love a rat?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.
synonyms: Please Love Even a Rat Like Me

title.english: A Cat Can Even Love a Rat

200018.description:
“I just wanted to become… the world's strongest!”
An archmage dies with his dream unfulfilled, only to find himself then reincarnated into the royal family. What's more, his new body is gifted with great abilities when it comes to close combat! In the hope of reaching the very top this time… he is given the name Evangeline—indeed, he turned female. Now living the life of a princess, muscle training and fighting are obviously off the table, but that doesn't stop Eva from secretly lifting dumbbells and swinging the sword in her bedroom! Thus, before she knows it—she became the strongest!? A tomboy princess power climb fantasy!

(Source: Pocket Magazine, translated)

200020.description:
Despite belonging to a family of esteemed knights, Felice has talent for magic and becomes the youngest imperial archmage in history. But his brilliance leaves someone in the shadows: Aeris, the heir to a renowned family of mages who was expected to become the next archmage. Driven by a bitter inferiority complex, Aeris casts a dark curse on himself. When Felice arrives to save his childhood friend, he discovers that he can only lift the curse by sleeping with him. In this twisted game of lust and obsession, can Felice heal the heart he inadvertently broke?

(Source: Tappytoon)

200021.description:
Katsura Chikage can see “demons” that invisible to ordinary people. One day, she finds a mysterious bracelet and is transported to the celestial realm. There she meets twin gods in training: Shinobu and Amane. Bound to Shinobu by the bracelet's power, Chikage ends up helping the two gods with their training!? A heart-pounding cohabitation with a tsundere god and a princely god begins!!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

200024.description:
What if cats appeared in those stories?

Momotaro, Cinderella, Ikkyu-san, and other famous folk tales and fairy tales that everyone knows are joined by cats! The addition of cats, who combine cuteness, brazenness, and lovability, to these wonderful folk tales will take the story in a new direction! It's very laid-back, and just as laid-back as you'd expect. A soothing cat manga that combines fairy tales and cats.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

200025.description:
“Can you teach me how to cook?!”

High schooler, Niwa Asahi, is secretly self-conscious of the fact that he eats snacks like bread for lunch every day. One day, in an unexpected turn of events, his classmate, Okuno, shared with him some food from his lunchbox. That was when Asahi realized…?

A yummy, wholesome tale where two polar opposites join up.

(Source: Shodensha, translated)

200026.description:
This holy night, a gentle miracle will happen... A dropout Santa and an elite Reindeer must do a practical exam on Christmas Eve, together!?

200028.description:
The world is plagued by demons. They attack people and livestock, and consume their souls. For some unknown reason, Lingling Wang seems to attract them. Knowing that exorcists are the only ones who can repel them, she travels from the eastern land of Jingluo all the way to the capital city to become a court attendant and meet the imperial exorcist.Meanwhile, the exorcist is worried that the spiritual power passed down to him from past generations has begun to dwindle. At the young age of seventeen, Feng Liang is the head of the imperial exorcists. He's been trying to translate tens of thousands of research documents that could potentially hold the secret to artificially enhance an exorcist's powers. At least, according to his father, who was an exorcist from the eastern lands. That's when the emperor's arrangement brings the two of them together.

Lingling's mysterious condition! A whirlpool of jealousy and resent from the other court attendants! Action-packed battles between the unfathomable demons and exorcists! And, the budding romance between Lingling and Feng...

The stage is set for a spectacular tale set at the imperial court!

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

A mysterious ghostwriting shop called "Ayashi no Fude" will write letters for you in exchange for a drop of youkai blood. The shop owner, Ayashi, receives various letter requests, from one youkai to another, and from youkai to humans...!?

The spin―off story of the massively popular comic, "The Imperial Court Maiden's Curse" has officially started！ Enjoy a peek into the everyday lives of the main characters, when they're more relaxed than in the main story！

200032.description:
Princess Hisui is married to the third prince of a neighboring country, Sakuyao, who is only 10 years old. However, there is a big secret behind this marriage. After learning the truth behind the events, Hisui makes a plan to escape, but Sakuyao finds out everything and stops her in a strange temple. There, someone locks the two of them inside, sets them on fire, and tries to kill them, but Hisui lets Sakuyao escape first and they manage to escape overnight...or so they think. In fact, 10 years have passed outside. Sakuyao, whose age has been transformed, has risen to the position of emperor and announces that he will make Hisui his wife...!?

(Source: Akita Shoten)

200033.description:
A royal mistress of the emperor. That's all Roen Setia could be to the man who loved her. But framed with the attempted murder of the empress and her unborn child, the punishment for such crime is death... The resentment of the betrayal of the emperor yields another life—another chance. Roen is the royal mistress once again, but this time, she curates a different life.Claiming revenge on the people that abandoned her and drove her to her death, she creates a new place for herself.

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

Visiting home after a long time away, Nao bumps into her first love Yuzuru who informs her of his upcoming wedding to their childhood friend, Suzu. But when Nao returns to Tokyo in shock, someone decides to show up at her door…?

200048.description:
He entered a co-ed high school, but ended up in an all-boys class...or so he thought, but there was only one girl there. She's not good with boys, but she wants to overcome that. Watch and support her as she struggles with her life - Nonoguchi!

200049.description:
Sophia, a talented maid in the service of the Count Lorraine, looks exactly like his daughter, the Countess Ange. She works for the Countess, to whom she is indebted, every day, making use of her ability to pretend to be Ange. However, Ange takes her own life after an incident. Sophia is determined to bring the culprit to justice, and decides to marry into the Marquise d'Auvers family, where she is convinced there is an avenger, by assuming Ange's identity!

A gorgeous love suspense begins!

(Source: Ura Sunday, translated)

Amanda, the daughter of a baron who works as an alchemist, is despised by her boss and father as incompetent and kicked out of the house. Then, a beautiful man appears before Amanda. His true identity is Calisto, the chairman of a large trading company and head of a marquis family. After being scouted by him, Amanda discovers that her alchemy skills are "too amazing"! And at her new workplace, she can fully utilize her beloved alchemy! Amanda is thrilled, but Calisto says, "My intuition is telling me never to let Amanda go." Does that mean she is an alchemist...?! Satisfying both work and love ♪ The Cinderella story of an unwitting genius alchemist!

(Source: Gaugau Monster, translated)

When her country of Lidea loses the war, Princess Tinalia must wed the enemy prince, Keith. The arrangement isn't as dire as it sounds, though: after all, Tinalia has been in love with Keith for years!

Unfortunately for her, Keith doesn't remember they already know each other. The circumstances of their first meeting were unfortunate, as their countries were at war, and Lidea committed too many atrocities against his people to forgive. Thus, Tinalia finds herself the hated bride of the crown prince, treated coldly and scornfully by everyone around her... even though she continues to love him with all her heart.

Gem works as a guard and guide in the desolate land of the Wasteland. One day, he receives a strange request from the powerful nation of Bab Iris, and is drawn into an epic adventure...!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

200067.description:
At the age of sixteen, Lillia awakened to her Holy powers and became the Saintess. Surprisingly, she retained memories of being a Saintess in her previous life as well. Fueled by frustration from the mistreatment she endured in her past life and the strict rules of the Temple, she vows to live her new life as she pleases once again as the Saintess.

As if guided by fate, Lillia crosses paths with two young men from her past life, drawn together through a series of peculiar events. In her second life as a Saintess, she begins to uncover the mysteries surrounding the role she holds. Amidst all these intertwining circumstances, a question lingers: Will Lillia achieve the freedom she dreams of and live her life on her own terms?

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

200068.description:

When she enters a girls' high school, Sou finds herself reunited with others who also possess memories of past lives— Toshizou Hijikata, Isami Kondo, and the other members of the Shinsengumi, who had once fought together during the tumultuous era.

synonyms: I'm a Grim Reaper, but I want to be Cupid!
雖然是陰差，卻想當邱比特！

200338.description:
After retiring from being a beloved idol, Lee Hyun-Seul struggles with depression and wastes his time, while Yoon Ho-Min, an art student struggling in poverty, holds on to his dream of becoming an artist. One day, Hyun-Seul stumbles upon an exhibition and is deeply comforted by Ho-Min's paintings. However, when Ho-Min tells him that his paintings aren't for sale, Hyun-Seul conceals his identity and begins to hover around Ho-Min, determined to get his hands on them. From that day on, Ho-Min is bewildered by a series of unexpected opportunities. Will Hyun-Seul be able to avoid Ho-Min's attention and obtain the paintings?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

200339.description:
Even if the heart forgets, the body remembers certain things. What comes vividly to mind when these two bodies entwine is the provocative image of an older brother...!?

(Source: Biblos, translated)

Note: Published in Magazine BE×BOY 1998-04

200340.description:
Mc, a fortune teller who can read human fate, uses chips embedded in the human finger to read their past and predict their future. As he encounters various people and gathers data, he gradually becomes more human, but he is actually a robot created for a specific purpose...!

This profound comic explores the psychological aspects of humanity's unique "irrational side," winning the 2016 SF Award for "Paranoid Android."

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

200341.description: Note: Originally published on the Pompompurin Twitter account on September 16, 2022, it was later acquired by Kodansha who released the first volume on September 15, 2023.

200342.description:
In a twist of fate, high schooler Umi Sayama finds herself moving in with the Hiroi family next door. There’s just one problem—their son, Sho, is her childhood crush, eight years her senior, and it’s been years since she last saw him. Just as she's wondering if seeing him again will be the meet-cute romance that will change her life, she finds out that the honor student that she once admired has been transformed into a scruffy manga artist. Though she can’t quite shake her old feelings, Umi is certain—it’s more than a first crush, but it’s definitely not love.

(Source: Square Enix)
synonyms: It's Not Quite Love Yet, but...

title.native: 恋と呼ぶにはささやかですが

synonyms: I Wish My Husband Were Dead

title.native: 夫が死んでくれて、助かったと思ったのに
title.romaji: Otto ga Shindekurete, Tasukatta to Omotta no ni

200344.description:
I'm sandwiched between a charismatic city gal and a pure and lovely Kyoto beauty... don't squish me!

I, Kurimoto Tsubame, moved to Tokyo from the countryside and now, for some reason, I'm being pressed tightly between two beautiful girls. How did it end up like this...? I just want to make up the bitter rivalry between Seira-chan and Orine-san...!

(Source: Fantasia Bunko, translated)

title.native: すぐケンカする都会ギャルと京美人を仲直りさせたいだけなのに! (※わたしを取り合うのはやめなさい!)
title.romaji: Sugu Kenka Suru Tokai Gyaru to Kyou-bijin wo Nakanaori Sasetai Dake na no ni! (※Watashi wo Toriau no wa Yamenasai!)

200345.description:
"Priest...may I pray?"

The girl who came to church was Saint Reina Laurel, the one who would one day save the world. Reincarnated as Clael Byrne, a mob priest in the world of an otome game, I met her at a temple in a rural town. Her emaciated body and shabby clothes—to save Reina from the oppression of the game's harsh scenario, I decided to become her surrogate parent. I fed her, bathed her, bought her clothes, and showed her the love of a surrogate parent...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: モブ司祭だけど、この世界が乙女ゲームだと気づいたのでヒロインを育成します
title.romaji: Mob Shisai Dakedo, Kono Sekai ga Otome Game dato Kizuita node Heroine o Ikusei Shimasu

title.romaji: Isekai Mononoke Onsenkyou: AV Danyu ga Ero Tech de Kami Musou!

モブなボクらも恋をする。

title.english: Monster ❤ Mating Tales - The Dragon Chapter
title.native: 異類♡性交譚~ドラゴニュートの場合~』

200356.description:
Sig worked as a versatile blacksmith in an S-rank guild. Fed up with the exploitative work environment, he decides to leave the guild! Sig, who loves forging katanas above all else, chooses to live a peaceful life in the countryside. However, the swords he crafts begin to influence the world!? The ideal slow life of the strongest blacksmith pursuing his craft at his own pace begins with a bang!

(Source: Starts Shuppan, translated)
synonyms: The Leisurely Frontier Life of a Katana Blacksmith Who Left an S-Rank Guild: After Escaping From a Black Company Guild and Forging Freely, I Accidentally Created a Legendary Demon Sword

title.native: S級ギルドを離脱した刀鍛冶の自由な辺境スローライフ～ブラックギルドから解放されて気ままに鍛冶してたら、伝説の魔刀が生まれていました～
title.romaji: S-kyuu Guild wo Ridatsu shita Katana Kaji no Jiyuu na Henkyou Slow Life: Black Guild kara Kaihou sarete Kimama ni Kaji shitetara, Densetsu no Matou ga Umareteimashita

title.native: バツイチ狐と旅ごはん

200358.description:
After graduating from high school, the protagonist, Yang, passes the civil service exam. However, despite his desire for a stable life, he is inexplicably assigned to the special department known as the M Department, which is tasked with dealing with transformed humans. The members of the M Department primarily use special weapons to combat these transformed humans, who blend into the crowd by appearing as ordinary people.

(Source: iQIYI, translated)

200360.description:
Kim Min-Su, a 35-year-old salaryman at an ordinary company, lives a monotonous life. He has a girlfriend, but his days blur together as he endures a borderline-abusive boss and trudges through work. One day, while on a date, he runs into a middle school classmate. Luxury car, beautiful partner, glamorous lifestyle: everything Min-Su isn't. Consumed by feelings of inferiority, he impulsively makes an investment that, against all odds, becomes wildly successful. Now a multimillionaire, he reinvents everything: his job, his relationship, his home. A new life begins. Yet somehow, the dream life he's obtained feels strangely hollow. Then, out of nowhere, a young girl appears claiming to be "Min-Su's daughter". What is her true purpose? And what lies ahead for Min-Su?

(Source: Piccoma, translated)

title.native: ふたなり姉ちゃんといっしょにだそっ！！
title.romaji: Futanari Nee-chan to Issho ni Daso!!

title.native: 私にこんな口聞いて、親ガチャ失敗したのか
title.romaji: Watashi ni Konna Kuchi Kiite, Oya Gatcha Shippai shita no ka

title.native: 追放幼女の領地開拓記～シナリオ開始前に追放された悪役令嬢が民のためにやりたい放題した結果がこちらです～
title.romaji: Tsuihou Youjo no Ryouchi Kaitakuki: Scenario Kaishi Mae ni Tsuihou Sareta Akuyaku Reijou ga Tami no Tame ni Yaritai Houdai Shita Kekka ga Kochira desu

200365.description:
The mightiest hero, holding both the supreme title of “Magic Saint” among mages and “Sword Saint” among swordsmen, returns to the world 1000 years after becoming a legend!

Barua Wesgarden, the “Magic Sword Saint” who mastered both magic and swordsmanship and etched his name at the pinnacle of human history, once faced the absolute Demon King Giranhel in a battle to determine humanity’s survival. However, due to interference from a mysterious force, both Barua and Giranhel lost their lives.

For 1000 years, Barua’s soul remained bound to the world, burdened by the regret of dying before achieving his goal. But when a boy named Direa Wesgarden, who idolized the Magic Sword Saint, is fatally attacked by monsters, Barua seizes the opportunity to return to the living world by inhabiting Direa’s body.

Now, as Direa—who was once considered a failure—Barua, the legendary Magic Sword Saint, must navigate the world of 1000 years later. This time, can he truly protect the peace of humanity?
synonyms: The Magic Sword Saint: The Legend Reborn
Legendary Return of the Magic Sword Saint

title.native: 魔導剣聖ー伝説の帰還ー

200366.description:
"If you were to disappear... I might just lose myself."

Arcs is reborn into the world of the wildly popular otome game Celestia Kingdom. He thought he was just a background character—until it's revealed he's actually the childhood friend of the final boss! Determined to avoid the bad ending, he throws himself into his daily life as her servant. But it seems the true cause of her descent into darkness is... her childhood friend!?

An unpredictable tale of master and servant, between a slightly (maybe more than slightly?) yandere heroine and an obliviously overpowered protagonist, begins...!

(Source: Hifumi Shobo, translated)
synonyms: I Reincarnated as the Villainess’ Childhood Friend Who Falls into Darkness. If I Die, It’s a Guaranteed Bad End, So I Became the Strongest… but Hasn’t She Already Fallen into Darkness [and Turned Yandere]?

title.native: 闇堕ちラスボス令嬢の幼馴染に転生した。俺が死んだらバッドエンド確定なので最強になったけど、もう闇堕ち【ヤンデレ化】してませんか？
title.romaji: Yamiochi Last Boss Reijou no Osananajimi ni Tensei Shita. Ore ga Shindara Bad End Kakutei nanode Saikyou ni Natta kedo, Mou Yamiochi [Yandere-ka] Shitemasen ka?

200367.description:
Mikan, a young girl transported to a world of swords and magic, grows up to become a great mage who saves that world from crisis—only to be sent back to her hometown, Niigata. Having lost her magic and companions from the other world, Mikan becomes a shut-in. Her older brother Itsuki, who has waited ten long years for her return, does everything he can to show her the joys of this world and gently coax her outside—but will he succeed…?!

(Source: Comic Gardo, Translated)
synonyms: I Left My Magic Behind in Another World. A Terrible New Game for Little Sister Who Was Once a Genius Mage.

title.native: 魔法は異世界に置いてきました。　～天才魔導士だった妹のよわくてニューゲーム～
title.romaji: Mahou wa Isekai ni Oitekimashita.: Tensai Madoushi Datta Imouto no Yowakute New Game

200368.description:
Though he always wanted to be a detective, Rihito is unfortunately unable to pay the bills to keep the lights on in his office, so he turns to work as a handyman. He takes on all sorts of odd jobs but, one day, he gets a request to sleep with a client’s wife and allow it to be filmed. How can he possibly refuse? It’s always important to meet the client’s needs.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title.native: 便利屋さんは寝取り屋さん

200369.description:
Jae-Hee loves Jeong so much that he stays his friend even after Jeong gets married and has his son, Yoo-Ahn. Hearing little Yoo-Ahn calling his mom triggers Jae-Hee's jealousy, and he tells Yoo-Ahn to call him ""Mom"" when they're alone. Unfortunately, this becomes a kink that makes it impossible for Jae-Hee to be around Jeong and his family, and he ghosts them soon after. But when Jae-Hee runs into Yoo-Ahn 14 years later, Yoo-Ahn not only remembers Jae-Hee's shameful kink but also confesses his love for the older man! Could their impulsive night together be the start of a questionable romantic relationship...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: Odd Relations: Fan Letters From My Fake Mom

200370.description:
After their troubled teen years together, Won-Seo thinks he'll never see his adopted brother, Joo-Hyeon, again. So his life is thrown off balance when Joo-Hyeon suddenly returns to Korea as an adult and shows up at Won-Seo's door. Not only does he act suspiciously playful around Won-Seo, but he even seduces him on his first day back, triggering Won-Seo's repressed feelings of lust and obsession. Even as their bodies mix, there's a question lingering in the air: What could Joo-Hyeon want with Won-Seo after all these years?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.english: Odd Relations: An Eye for an Eye

200371.description:
"Does sex feel that good?"

Amanda is a girl who is interested in sex. With the recommendation from her friend, she meets a guy through online chat. After having her first taste of a guy, her life becomes full of naughty days.

(Source: TOPTOON)

200380.description:
On the day their favorite idol group disbands, a couple stands together in silence in a quiet corner of the venue. Their own relationship is also approaching a crossroads...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

200382.description:
During the Edo period, all sexual relations between men and women other than those between husband and wife were considered adultery. Premarital sex, adultery, double suicide, and rape by monks were all sexual crimes. Despite harsh penalties, including the death penalty, Edo men and women freely enjoyed sex. This film vividly depicts the events that unfolded between a man and a woman who engaged in adultery.

(Source: Comic Border, translated)

title.native: 江戸の不倫は死の香り
title.romaji: Edo no Furin wa Shi no Kaori

200383.description:
Rio, a boy living in a remote village, attends the village dojo for self-defense, but gives up, feeling that he cannot become stronger under the dojo's teaching methods. However, the village is a dangerous place, and Rio decides to create his own way of fighting—"Garyu Kenjutsu"—in order to survive! A royal road fantasy of swords and magic is about to begin!

(Source: Mag Garden, translated)

title.native: 見切りから始める我流剣術

200386.description:
Hailen, the son of the Emmast Dukes. At the age of ten, he discovers he is not of the Dukes' bloodline. He even discovers that his biological mother switched him with the Dukes' son, and he subsequently hates the true Dukes' son, Gaillont. However, the more he conceals the truth and tries to eliminate Gaillont, the more he sinks into the abyss. Only on the verge of death does he acknowledge his ugly inferiority complex and close his eyes in regret.

"Damn that inferiority complex, you foolish Hailen."

When Hailen opens his eyes again, he finds himself back at the age of ten. Having regressed, Hailen abandons his hatred and obsession with Gaillont and resolves to one day abandon his position as the Dukes' son and begin a new life. He puts his plans into action, step by step...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

200387.description:
Was it creative differences, personal conflicts, or money troubles? What made three close friends suddenly break up? A new one-shot by Kokoro Onodera!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

200388.description:
Yukiya is excited to start his first year at school, but his enthusiasm quickly dissipates when he is assigned a surly, aloof upperclassman for a roommate.

Note: Published in Junk! BOY Summer 2000.

title.native: 楽しい同室生活の条件

200391.description:
Theo was taken in by the wizard Klaus when he was a child. Even though Theo is Klaus's disciple, he grew feelings for his mentor but spends his days taking care of him without daring to confess. One day, Klaus hears that the price for obtaining a precious magical material is spending one night with the king of a foreign country...

"If you can give yourself over that easily then give yourself to me-!"

Can the out of control Theo really spellbind Klaus?

200392.description:
During peaceful days, the free-spirited demon Kaisel suddenly receives a visit from a priest who unexpectedly proposes a relationship. Despite Kaisel 's bold ambition to abandon his virginity, the priest possesses no knowledge of sexual relations, and Kaisel is intrigued. He offers to teach him everything, from beginning to end...

"It's a good thing for me to lose a priest..."

"I will sacrifice myself to grant your wish."

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

200393.description:
Unseon Kang’s master has been killed before his very eyes – and now he is the only one alive who knows the secrets that his master wrote about. Anyone he meets could be an enemy who will stop at nothing to gain those secrets. Now he must try to navigate a world in which he can trust nobody while trying to obtain martial arts skills that will help him grow stronger. Will he be able to keep his secrets out of enemy hands and avenge his master’s death?

(Source: WEBTOON)

200394.description:
Tae-Eun is an omega who relies heavily on his alpha little brother, Tae-Ho. It’s not just because of his fragile health; the only reason he was adopted from a children’s home into the wealthy Kwon family was because a young Tae-Ho claimed he wanted Tae-Eun. Ever since then, Tae-Eun has needed his little brother as an anchor in the unwelcoming sea that is the Kwon household. In fact, he wants Tae-Ho as more than a brother. However, what Tae-Eun doesn’t realize is that Tae-Ho has changed his life in more ways than he ever knew since their first meeting…

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

200395.description:
Sarang Baek has always been happiest alone. Pyeonghwa Yu has always been happiest with others, even when it means putting himself at risk of heartbreak. When these two total opposites meet, they begin to change the way they see life, love, and themselves. Follow Sarang and Pyeonghwa for a romance that's surprisingly grown-up, surprisingly childish, and, at times, a little too real.

(Source: WEBTOON)

200396.description:
Uta is a nurse by day, diligently carrying out her duties, but there's more to her than meets the eye. In her secret life, she's an aspiring writer penning BL (Boys' Love) novels. During her time as a nursing student, she observed the close bond between Iwasaki and Takeuchi, two talented surgery residents. Inspired by their friendship, Uta began weaving stories with them as her models. However, everything takes an unexpected turn when Iwasaki and Takeuchi discover Uta's work. Suddenly, she finds herself on the receiving end of disapproving glances from her colleagues, feeling completely cornered.....

(Source: Mangamo)

200397.description:
"Did you just complain to me?" Asuka is married to a man with a high income, but she is unable to resist the power balance within the household and suffers from financial domestic violence. Even after discovering her husband's infidelity, she cannot divorce and become independent because she has no income. But then, someone appears who is interested in her needlework skills, which she has been doing as a hobby...!?

(Source: Mecha Comic, translated)

title.native: リファイン サレ主婦の逆転
ポーション、わが身を助ける

200399.description:
The Rabbit Princess is the princess of the rabbit kingdom.

Her daily life surrounded by many animals is heartwarming and cute... but it's not just that! Is there something poisonous about cute things? This surreal fairy tale manga is heartwarming, yet you can't let your guard down for even a single frame; it's an addictive roller coaster ride of relaxation and tension!

(Source: Shogakukan Creative, translated)

Note:
- Originally sel-published on the author’s Twitter and Pixiv accounts since May 6, 2022, and later compiled and licensed by Shogakukan on January 18, 2024.
- Includes one extra chapter.

200401.description:
A bold offer from the burly, innocent loan shark Jeong Hyeok-Su to the slender college student Lee Eun-Hu! 50 in one go! What should he do? Jun-Hu, Eun-Hu's troublemaker younger brother, is in big trouble this time. He borrowed money from a loan shark and couldn't pay it back! Eun-Hu stands before Hyeok-Su to pay off his brother's debt, but is completely discouraged when he hears his size and the amount... However, although he boasts in front of Hyeok-Su that he will pay it back, he is at a loss as to how to repay it... No matter how much he pays, there is no end in sight, and Eun-Hu is struggling, so Hyeok-Su makes a secret offer...

Eun-Hu has a hard time understanding Hyeok-Su's offer, and Hyeok-Su can't wait for Eun-Hu's answer. Should he just let it go?

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

200402.description: Note: Published in COMIC Kairakuten XTC Vol. 3

synonyms: [เรื่องสั้นเร้าสวาท] รักนี้คืนสนอง

title.romaji: Gangnyeongeun Hamburo Haeseon An Doemnida: Tteokbangajeon

200404.description:
Kim Chan-Wook, a 24-year-old Korean businessman, just discharged from the military. Unskilled, with a meager bank account and mounting debts, he tries to find work to somehow manage his finances, but the world is not easy. Then one day, with the help of a close senior colleague, he visits an office... and the job he's given is none other than a bathhouse cleaner.

"If you just work hard at cleaning, even a dimwitted hyung can be useful here."

(Source: BookCube, translated)

200406.description:
She married to wealthy old men in their death bed to help her family. People called her "Lady Caregiver." She never hoped to be happy herself until...

Cornelia Rosenblatt, eighteen years old, was on her way to Duke Spencer's estate for her third marriage. Although she was a bride, she didn't look happy--she was being forced to marry this old man, almost dying, by her father for the third time. Her father, Baron Rosenblatt, made contract with rich noble men who wished to be cared by a young, beautiful wife. In return, he earned money to pay his debts. Cornelia cared for her first husband and second husband as earnestly as she could. They lived longer than anyone had expected...and people started to call her "Lady Caregiver." She had long since given up on the prospect of a happy marriage. This is a story of a young sweet girl who finds love and happiness at last.

(Source: Kadokawa)
synonyms: Don’t Mind Me, I’m Just a Black Widow x 3

title.native: バツ3の看取り夫人と呼ばれていますので捨て置いてくださいませ
title.romaji: Batsu 3 no Mitori Fujin to Yobareteimasu no de Suteoite Kudasaimase

200407.description:
Forte, the daughter of a duke who works as a fortune teller while hiding her true identity, is falsely accused one day and is threatened by the crown prince's aide and ordered to "find the mastermind behind the murder of the prince and queen among the three noblewomen in the harem!" Faced with the prospect of being jailed if she fails, Forte disguises herself as a maid and begins investigating the harem, where she is aided by the mysterious black knight Alto. But what is his true identity, the man who knows so much about the royal palace...?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.romaji: Seiryaku Kekkon no Otto ni ''Aisanakute Kekkou desu'' to Sengen Shitara Dekiai ga Hajimarimashita

200410.description:
A romantic comedy about an arrogant and mischievous crown prince and a hardworking baron's daughter! Claudia, the daughter of a baron, has always been able to charm people. She unconsciously casts charm spells that cause trouble for Prince Albert.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated and edited)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.romaji: Fushigi no Kuni no Heart no Joou

200413.description:
Florence, the princess of Escatronea, a great nation known as the "Kingdom of Flower Crowns," suffers from a severe allergy to flowers! She is constantly sneezing and has a runny nose, which is unbecoming of a lady (and so on). But then a turning point in her life comes! She is approached by Prince Isca of the northern border country of Laha Radoma, and is proposed to marry him. Florence is excited, thinking that this barren land where she has no allergies is her paradise, but Isca is suspicious of her and asks why she is marrying the princess of a great nation!? Is there a future for this marriage that began as a calculation?!

(Source: KADOKAWA, translated)

title.native: 花冠の王国の花嫌い姫
title.romaji: Kakan no Oukoku no Hanagirai Hime

200414.description:
A romantic comedy about misunderstandings that begins with a strange political marriage!!

Florence, the princess of a great, blossoming nation, suffers from a severe flower allergy! With the goal of marrying to a barren land where she won't have any symptoms, she pursues a marriage with Prince Iska, a prince from a remote northern nation, but her friends are suspicious, asking, "Why is the princess of a great nation in such a remote place!?"

(Source: KADOKAWA, translated)

title.native: 花冠の王国の花嫌い姫
title.romaji: Kakan no Oukoku no Hanagirai Hime

200415.description:
Roselinde was raised in the traditional manner and is hailed as the saintliest of saints, but she's a coward at heart and a reclusive princess with no friends she can speak honestly with. Her true nature is discovered by the wind god knight, Elheine!

"Let's improve. You must act like a proper saint."

Even if you're not like a saint, I want you to help protect the country.

A fantasy romance about saving the country with eccentric knights!

(Source: KADOKAWA, translated)

200416.description:
Lulu has transferred to the prestigious Mirus Claire Magic Academy. She lacks the "attributes" that magicians should have, and if she doesn't find them within a certain time frame, her magical powers will be sealed away! Encouraged by her friends, including Julius, who is interested in her magic, Lulu studies hard, but one day she hears rumors of a mysterious "darkness" appearing! She gets her friends involved and sets out to solve the case, but... it turns out to be an incident that will affect Lulu's future!?

(Source: KADOKAWA, translated)

title.native: ワンド オブ フォーチュン

200418.description:
Duke Emilia's dream is to marry for love, just like in her favorite romance novels. Then, she receives an offer for a political marriage with King Matthias, who is rumored to be a misogynist... If that's the case, Your Majesty, let's fall in love together!

(Source: KADOKAWA, translated)

title.native: わたくし、恋愛結婚がしたいんです。
title.romaji: Watakushi, Renai Kekkon ga Shitain desu.

200419.description:
Angelic smiles… raunchy sex. ♥

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten 2025-11

200420.description:
The strong eat the weak! ♥ Gimme your cock!

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten 2025-05

200421.description:
A pure love story of doting love between a troubled and stubborn king and a pushy, air-headed young lady! Duchess Emilia's dream is to have an exciting love marriage like in a romance novel. Then, an arranged marriage with King Matthias, the boy Emilia thinks was her first love, comes her way... But it's rumored that he hates women!?

So, let's fall in love together during this engagement period!

"Your lunch, Shimoya-san? Pathetic~!"

Poor high school girl Hinako Shimoya lives in poverty and is left all alone in class because of it. But when the ultra-rich heiress Okumi Kanamori takes a bite of Hinako's homemade lunch, her delighted cry of "This is my first time~!" echoes through the room. A clash of poverty and privilege— as the two girls share more and more "first times" together, a friendship that money can't buy begins to blossom in this offbeat school comedy.

Source: Comipo (Translated)

title.native: はじめてですわ～！ 億美お嬢様は貧子ちゃんをベタ褒める
title.romaji: Hajimete Desu wa! Okumi Ojou-sama wa Hinako-chan wo Beta Homeru

200531.description:
Arnoick, the strongest Sword Saint in history, has died. His sword techniques were passed on to his disciples, and it was thought that his story had come to an end—

But then…! Arnoick is reincarnated as a breathtakingly beautiful maid named Annette!

With her slender arms and frail body, she should have given up the path of the sword and lived a quiet, peaceful life. However, in order to protect Rosalena, the daughter of a fallen noble family, she rises up broom in hand.

An ultimate do-over fantasy of the strongest warrior reborn—from old man to beautiful girl!

(Comic Gardo Translated)
synonyms: The strongest sword saint is reincarnated as a beautiful maid and becomes unrivaled with a broom

title.native: 最強の剣聖、美少女メイドに転生し箒で無双する
title.romaji: Saikyou no Kensei, Bishoujo Maid ni Tensei Shi Houki de Musou Suru

title.native: お前の表情を確かめたい
異世界転移した俺は、Hのたびにガチャを引く！～もってくれ、俺の精力！～
title.romaji: Isekai Teni Shita Ore wa, H no Tabi ni Gacha wo Hiku!: Motte Kure, Ore no Seiryoku!

200541.description:
Eun-chae, a freshman, dreamed of a fun campus life at university, but on the school's orientation day, she received an unexpected assignment.

"From now on, there will be a regular assignment once a week. The assignment's content is..."

"A hole inspection."

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
synonyms: What, a Hole Inspection is Homework?

200543.description:
After her fiancé, who worked at the same company, cheated on her, Yura quit the job she loved and moved out of her new apartment - currently unemployed and with no fixed address. One night, while sleeping rough in a park, Yura was harassed by a drunk man and was saved by her younger childhood friend, Hodaka, whom she hadn't seen in 10 years. "I guess I'll get you to pay for my lodging with my body," he suggested, and she ended up staying with him, but... her cute childhood friend, like a puppy, is no longer there!? Yura is confused after seeing Hodaka's manly side...

(Source: Cmoa Comics, translated)

title.native: 幼なじみは不埒な飼い犬

200544.description:
The story takes place in a world where a new, toxic organism known as "void" has appeared. The only ones who can fight against the void are the "toxients," known as "poisonous men," who possess poison in their bodies. Today, they set out on a mission to eradicate the voids, for the sake of peace for humanity. This is a battle action fantasy in which the poisonous men fight poison with poison.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: Toxic-a-Holic トキシカホリック Alternate Episode

200545.description: Nakajima Mio, a 31-year-old woman who spends her days feeling depressed, finds that the only way to relax in life is to watch the live streams of a cooking streamer, a male college student who loves cooking. One day, when she posts a complaint on social media as usual, she receives a DM from "a male college student who loves cooking"...

title.native: 死にたいあなたに男子大学生がお肉をごちそうしてくれるだけのお話
title.romaji: Shinitai Anata ni Danshi Daigakusei ga wo Niku wo Gochisou Shite Kureru Dake no Ohanashi

title.native: ドール 無知な人造乙女たち エイダ編
title.romaji: Doll Muchi na Jinzou Otome-tachi: Ada-hen

200547.description:
In a village where legends of an ancient dragon god remain, Mikoto lives a lonely life, unable to rely on her adoptive family. But what awaited Mikoto was a cruel fate: to be sacrificed to the dragon god. As Mikoto prepares for death and sinks into the depths of despair, the one to whom she can offer herself appears before her - the dragon god Momonoe.

But then he tells her, "I will take this girl as my bride."

For some reason, Mikoto is welcomed as a "bride" rather than a sacrifice, and is taken aback. And yet, the love that Momoe showers upon her is unexpectedly sweet and overwhelming...!? A fantasy of interspecies marriage woven by a lonely girl and the dragon god who rules the Water Kingdom, a destined couple!

(Source: CLLENN, translated)

title.native: 恋する龍神と贄の花嫁
title.romaji: Koisuru Ryuujin to Nie no Hanayome

200548.description: The second season of Yakuza in Love.
synonyms: ตกหลุมรัก! ยากูซ่าพ่อลูกติด 2

200549.description:
The Dawson Group changed the world with their line of pheromone-regulating medications. The long line of alphas in the Dawson family has never failed to uphold that legacy—until now. Henry, the eldest son and successor, has a secret that could ruin his family’s reputation and bring down the company if it were ever to get out. He’s a beta, borrowing the alpha pheromones of his adopted brother, Raz. With so much at stake, will he be able to accept his illicit desires to keep this arrangement?

(Source: Tapas)

200550.description:
After an unwanted breakup, Ha-Won ends up living with his estranged stepbrother, Chae-Woon. Contrary to his worries, meeting his brother is not as awkward as he thought, and they gradually narrow the gap as they reminisce about their childhood. However, while Ha-Won lets his guard down, Chae-Woon explodes with a secret desire he has been secretly nurturing...

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

title.native: 夜は千の目をもっている
title.romaji: Yoru wa Sen no Me wo Motteiru

200553.description:
Notes:
- All chapters were split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume release.
- Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 須田先輩はオトせない

200554.description:
Yeon-Jin, whose shoulders have become stiff from a long career, is recommended to [Dang's Massage Shop] by a friend, and receives treatment from the director, Hyun-Hu...

"Would it be okay if I do some special treatment?"

With each special treatment, her body gets hotter and hotter, and Yeon-Jin loses her reason and attacks Hyun-Hu.

"Aren't you hot, sir? My whole body is hot..."

Will Yeon-Jin be able to regain her health with Hyun-Hu's special treatment?

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

200555.description:
"Lady Bumpkin"—that is what most of high society called Agnes Evantail, eldest daughter of the venerable House of Evantail. Ridiculed for her outdated makeup and antiquated clothing, she has been a pariah among her peers for as long as she can remember.

After yet another failed attempt at becoming engaged, her parents make her attend the princess's engagement celebration in hopes of finding a fiancé there. Agnes begrudgingly goes to the party, where she encounters perfect Nazelbart Florescruz, the princess's fiancé, and the only person to ever show her kindness. When the princess schemes against him and he's branded a villain, it's Agnes's turn to offer him a helping hand.

The two are then bound together in the most unlikely turn of events—how will their story unfold?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: Lady Bumpkin and Her Lord Villain
title.native: 芋くさ令嬢ですが悪役令息を助けたら気に入られました
title.romaji: Imo Kusa Reijou desu ga Akuyaku Reisoku wo Tasuketara Kiniiraremashita

200557.description:
Thrown into the world of a reverse harem novel, Lila becomes the guide every esper covets. All she wants is to break free from the chains of the cliché and carve her own life, but each man she tries to avoid seems only more determined to claim her. With the weight of destiny closing in, Lila must choose to either defy the tale itself or surrender to the bonds that refuse to release her.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Korean.

title.english: How to Escape an Esper Harem

200558.description:
Corporate slave Kamisato Nina catches the last train home again today, and as she cooks rice, she is summoned to another world as a saint along with her rice cooker. However, a beautiful girl who was summoned at the same time is deemed to be a saint, and Nina immediately concludes that she is not. She is banished from the royal capital. Abandoned, all she has left is the rice cooker that was summoned along with it. Just as she is wondering what to do, a puppy comes along...? This is the story of a beautiful young servant (sacred beast) and a former corporate slave and exiled saint, as they go on a thrilling and heart-pounding journey while cooking meals.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: 聖女じゃないと追放されたので、もふもふ従者(聖獣)とおにぎりを握る
title.romaji: Seijo ja Nai to Tsuihou Sareta node, Mofumofu Juusha (Seijuu) to Onigiri wo Nigiru

200559.description:
"Shut up!"

The third prince of the Kingdom of Brasio and the daughter of a baron are being condemned by a villainous young lady who interferes with their relationship. This is a common scene these days, but Imperial Princess Claudia appears accompanied by her servant Beryl, cutting through it all. With her overwhelming presence, she quickly takes control of the situation, forcing the girl who dreams of a prince with no sense of responsibility and the villainous duke's daughter to face reality!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: 高飛車皇女は黙ってない

200561.description:
Toru Hitogata, a dollmaker fated to die at 27, throws himself into deadly combat with the cursed Jinkan Doll to fulfill his destiny.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

200562.description:
It’s easy to love everything about a cat, and one cat owner truly loves everything about her cat–especially its butt! A pawsitively hiss-terical full-color comic about the hilarious antics of a woman and her cat.

If you think you’re a fan of cats, can you profess your love of cat butts without batting an eye? Or do you cringe in disgust whenever they shove it in your face? In this collection of colorful comics, one woman is completely devoted to her furry feline friend and adores one feature specifically: his butt! An unhinged comedy about a woman and her chaotic cat.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

为什么大家都爱猫屁屁

200565.description:
Once saved as a child by a boy who appeared like a flame, Jang Do-Ha reunites with his savior and confesses his love. But Kang Tae-Jun knows the truth. Do-Ha’s feelings are not love. He has returned for one reason only, revenge.

(Source: Lezhin US)

200567.description:
For years, Saint Evelyn has protected her country with her powerful healing magic, earning her the love of the people. But then, the first prince breaks off their engagement and strips her of her title, only to name her incompetent half sister as the new saint. Cast out from the only life she's ever known, Evelyn is forced to find her place in a world that suddenly feels all too vast.

Fate smiles upon her when she stumbles upon a young boy from the streets who shows her a new path: making a living with her healing magic. The next thing she knows, she's earned her first commission—and a handsome count is proposing to her?!

With discontent growing in the royal family over the prince's folly and adoring fans flocking to her side, Evelyn must navigate political intrigue, newly realized fame, and unexpected romance in the air. Now if only she would realize just how much everyone adores her!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: Even Exiled, She’s Still the Beloved Saint! St. Evelyn’s Weird and Wonderful Friends
title.native: 追放された聖女ですが、実は国中から愛されすぎてて怖いんですけど! ?
title.romaji: Tsuihou Sareta Seijo desu ga, Jitsu wa Kunijuu kara Aisare Sugitete Kowain desu kedo!?

200568.description:
Lumina, the younger sister, has been working diligently as an alchemist at the royal court in place of her older sister, who spends all her time playing around. She can't rely on her older sister, parents, or even her fiancé. As she endures her loneliness, her older sister and fiancé suddenly break off their engagement and inform her that she will be transferred to the frontier.

Expecting to see them grieving over the loss of their position and fiancé, Lumina heads to the frontier, only to find that his majesty, Prince Elms of the Ratman Kingdom, is waiting for her!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 無自覚天才錬金術師の辺境街づくり～傍若無人な姉の代わりに働かされていた妹、辺境領地に左遷されたと思ったら待っていたのは王子様でした!?～
title.romaji: Mujikaku Tensai Renkinjutsushi no Henkyou Machizukuri: Boujakubujin na Ane no Kawari ni Hatarakasarete Ita Imouto, Henkyou Ryouchi ni Sasensareta to Omottara Matte Ita no wa Ouji-sama Deshita!?

200569.description:
Be impassive in all things. When dealing with your enemies, be ruthless! Merciless! Thoroughly! He who calls himself the world! I, Heuk-Su, will cut down that world and quell the bloody wind!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

200570.description:
Hailed as a genius, Metea became the Chief Saint at the age of eighteen...only to be abruptly ordered into exile. Relieved to be freed from the crushing burden of singlehandedly supporting the Central Temple, she sets off on her journey with a radiant smile. Along the way, she encounters the knight Lionel, and together they travel to save those in need. Though their first meeting is anything but pleasant, the distance between them gradually begins to close.

Will the mightiest exiled Saint end up saving the entire world!? An exhilarating heroic fantasy!!

(Source: Kadokawa)

title.english: Exiled? So What! A Genius Saint Can Shine Anywhere!
title.native: 追放上等! 天才聖女のわたくしは、どこでだろうと輝けますので。
title.romaji: Tsuihou Joutou! Tensai Seijo no Watakushi wa, Doko de Darou to Kagayakemasu no de.

200571.description:
A young lady who finds her calling begins her "great turnaround in her happy life"!

Meer, who works at the guild reception desk, witnesses her fiancé cheating on her just before retiring. After breaking off her engagement, she receives an unexpected offer to become the "court alchemist's assistant"!? This is the start of a work fantasy about a young lady who finds her calling!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 蔑まれた令嬢は、第二の人生で憧れの錬金術師の道を選ぶ ～夢を叶えた見習い錬金術師の第一歩～
title.romaji: Sagesumareta Reijou wa, Daini no Jinsei de Akogare no Renkinjutsushi no Michi wo Erabu: Yume wo Kanaeta Minarai Renkinjutsushi no Dai Ippo

200572.description:
From the ghost in the bathroom at Outback in Sinchon to the local god of the neighborhood shrine, we handle complaints about "everything" in Seoul. Ranked #1 in resident satisfaction! The complaint log of Jeong-Sol, a new civil servant at the Seoul Strange Tales Complaints Division. Seoul is a sacred land. A land of strange tales and myths, a land where all these sacred and strange beings coexist with humans. In the past, when spirits and strange tales were summoned through opportunity and prayer, today, when worldly events powerfully hold sway over humanity, mythical beings have taken up residence among us. And even these beings have their own "complaints."

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

200573.description:
Nobody understands why the wicked Belinda Blanche is giving special treatment to her child servant. They don't realize she's actually from the modern world, and her servant's the hero of her favorite childcare game! All Belinda wants is to give the hero the love he deserves, but the game keeps twisting her words to make her sound like a third-rate villain. Can Belinda beat the game and figure out how to fangirl without saying a single kind word? Or will she be forced to play the bad guy forever?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Adopting the Male Protagonist Changed the Genre
I Adopted the Protagonist, and the Genre Changed
Adopting the Protagonist, the Genre Switched

title.english: Adopting the Hero Changed the Genre

200574.description:
Princess Edel of Zerth, who grew up being oppressed by the queen and others because she was born to a concubine, is to be married off to the victorious country of Ostrom in place of her half-sister as compensation for losing a war. Her partner is Ortius, nicknamed the "Black Wolf King," a barbarian king rumored to have only the ability to fight with his beast-like body. However, on the day of the wedding ceremony, Edel meets a handsome young man with tall, black hair and an intelligent light in his eyes. Before long, their encounter develops into a situation that threatens the very survival of the kingdom...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

200580.description:
Fifty years after the fusion of the Game World and Reality, a top-tier warrior emerged. He dedicated his life to the world but was ultimately killed by the highest authority out of fear. Before his death, he awakened the SSS-Rank hidden skill [Mirror World] and sealed his soul beneath the surface of a lake. The King covered up the history and fabricated a new one; from then on, the warrior was known to the world as a traitor. Decades later, the warrior has awakened in the body of a dying man, using the [Mirror World] skill to begin his revenge.

(Source: WebComics)

Oshino Meme and Kaiki Deishuu, members of the Sakaimiyako University Occult Research Club, are invited by their senior and leader, Gaen Izuko, to take part in a forbidden ritual.
Together with the high school girl Kagenui Yozuru, they scramble to make preparations, but the project takes an unexpected turn─!

These are modern-day oddities! Oddities! Oddities!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

200590.description:
Buried in a suffocating hole: an after-school rendezvous. ❤

(Source: FAKKU)

200592.description:
Even with those eyes, you can't understand love!

Vivi, a young lady from the countryside who came to the royal capital to work in order to maintain the reputation of her baron family, is a seamstress who prioritizes functionality. Alex, the leader of the Holy Knights, happens to meet Vivi and falls in love at first sight! His doting heart never stops, and they end up living together!? There seems to be a deeper reason behind his actions, but to Vivi, who has no experience with love, it's all incomprehensible... The devoted love of the handsome, scheming duke is too much for a young lady like her.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: ド田舎出身の芋令嬢、なぜか公爵に溺愛される
title.romaji: Doinaka Shusshin no Imo Reijou, Nazeka Koushaku ni Dekiai Sareru

200593.description:
One day, Jun-Hyeon finds out that his female coworkers have been making bets about him. So, he begins getting his revenge on his female coworkers pulling lewd pranks on him.

(Source: TOPTOON, edited)
synonyms: 俺以外は全員女性で、皆ヤりたがっている会社で働いてます

200594.description:
Irina Lakers seem to have the picture-perfect life: wealth, a loving husband, and a family that cares for her. Just when she thought life couldn't get any better, her sweet and loving husband turned out to be the one who had been poisoning her for the past three years. What's worst is that the hidden culprit behind her death is actually...her dad! But when Irina finds herself back in time before she gets killed off, she vows to change her destiny and seeks to change her destined path by stealing Ian Lancaster's night...

(Source: POCKET COMICS)
synonyms: ขอบคุณที่หักหลัง

title.native: あなたの裏切りに感謝します

200595.description:
He wanted an heir. Not a heart.

Baek-Ryeon, a sacred dragon spirit, once took the human Ha-On as his mate, never realizing that love would be his undoing. When Ha-On discovers he was meant for nothing more than producing an heir, he vanishes, leaving Baek-Ryeon to face the centuries alone. Now, in the modern world, Baek-Ryeon meets a man with Ha-On’s soul and the same fire in his eyes. But with Ha-On having no recollection of their shared history, can Baek-Ryeon truly atone for the sins of the past?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.native: 劇画・吉展ちゃん事件 刑事

200597.description:
Who would have thought my idol would adore me?! A Cinderella story of an oppressed young lady!

After an accident while pursuing her idol, the protagonist is reincarnated as the daughter of a duke, Elysia. Because of her black hair and eyes, she is scorned and labeled the "daughter of evil." Hiding her saintly powers and determined to live in the shadows, Elysia is rescued by Crown Prince Reichelt at the royal castle.

"I've found my idol, even in this world!"

To earn money from her idol activities, she secretly starts working as a magician, and then a man with the exact same voice as Reichelt shows up at her shop!She's so focused on pursuing her idol that she doesn't notice his affection for her?! A Cinderella love story of an oppressed young lady!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 転生聖女は推し活がしたい! 虐げられ令嬢ですが推しの王子様から溺愛されています!?
title.romaji: Tensei Seijo wa Oshikatsu ga Shitai! Shiitagerare Reijou desu ga Oshi no Oujisama kara Dekiai Sareteimasu!?

200598.description:
A reincarnation fantasy in which the feelings of a saint and a demon king transcend a millennium.

Stella lives a peaceful life in a small village church. One day, while using her secret powers in the forest, she is seen by Vincent, a knight from a neighboring country. Vincent takes one look at Stella and... "I've been searching for you forever," he tells her. Stella decides to live with Vincent. Their feelings, connected across time from their past lives, begin to intertwine.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 転生聖女と元魔王の騎士
title.romaji: Tensei Seijo to Moto Maou no Kishi

200599.description:
She was meant to get revenge on her traitor, but now she's completely surrounded by the Duke's obsessive love!?

After being dumped by her ex-fiancé because he was a knight, Tiziano is proposed to by the Duke of her dreams. However, on the day of their wedding, she learns that the Duke has a lover... She was meant to get revenge on the traitor, but before she knew it, she was being pampered...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 初恋の人との晴れの日に令嬢は裏切りを知る　幸せになりたいので公爵様の求婚に騙されません
title.romaji: Hatsukoi no Hito to no Hare no Hi ni Reijou wa Uragiri wo Shiru Shiawase ni Naritai node Koushaku-sama no Kyuukon ni Damasaremasen

200600.description:
Nineteen years have passed without Emilia's saintly powers manifesting, and she's finally been exiled. Determined to finally live life the way she wants, she plans to open a pharmacy in a remote area! For a while, she has no customers, but then one incident causes rumors of her to spread throughout the village...

A reversal fantasy about a dropout saint who decides to live life the way she wants!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 追放された聖女ですが、どうやら私が本物です 前世薬師は“癒し”の薬で救いたい!
title.romaji: Tsuihou Sareta Seijo desu ga, Douyara Watashi ga Honmono desu: Zense Kusushi wa "Iyashi" no Kusuri de Sukuitai!

synonyms: I'm a Woman With a Strong Sense of Duty

title.native: 私、義理堅い女なんです

200605.description:
